foto-01.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: AAC vocabulary image. Style: synthetic photorealistic studio photograph, natural believable materials, real people and objects. Photograph of a real white paper desk calendar with two small metal binding rings, object only. A minimal three-day timeline: EXACTLY THREE equal blank calendar day cards in one horizontal row, each with one small yellow sun at top, no dates. The MIDDLE card is the fixed TODAY reference: a solid blue dot immediately below its center and a thin blue vertical line linking the dot to that middle card. ONLY the LEFT (FIRST), meaning YESTERDAY card is pale red with a bold red outline and one red downward arrow above it. Other cards white with gray outlines. Read left-to-right: previous day, current day, next day. Precisely distinguish selected LEFT (FIRST), meaning YESTERDAY day from the blue middle-day reference. The whole three-card strip and all arrows fully visible. No people, no labels, no writing or numbers.  Pure white background. One clear central concept, minimal necessary context, generous white margins on ALL sides. All people full body and all objects fully inside image, natural anatomy/hands. Anatomical detail may use natural body-part crop. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, punctuation, lettering, labels, branding, watermarks or pseudowriting anywhere, including tiny hardware and clothing. No border. Image square. Vocabulary word is displayed outside image by the app, never inside.

alt.ca: Tres dies amb l'anterior destacat i el dia actual indicat en blau.
alt.es: Tres días con el anterior resaltado y el día actual indicado en azul.
